statement: Hypothetical bankroll stress. NOT verified future ruin probability or an actual portfolio.

scenarioAssumptions.sample: Resample complete NFL season-week groups with replacement.
scenarioAssumptions.practicalRuin: Balance touches 50 units (half starting bankroll) at any time
scenarioAssumptions.stakeSizing: Fraction of current bankroll per historical hypothetical selection; no leverage
scenarioAssumptions.source: Historical closing odds, not actual bet execution
scenarioAssumptions.adverseCase: Declared 2% independent per-winning-selection conversion to a loss, not an observed real-world probability

limitations: Conditional resampling of historical, closing-price-only hypothetical decisions.
Historical win rates, odds and selection rules are assumed to remain informative; this is not established.
Week-block resampling only approximates within-week dependence and ignores changing opponent strength or sportsbook restrictions.
A 50% bankroll threshold is a practical stress trigger, not literal financial ruin.
Adverse win flips are a stated hypothetical assumption, not measured probabilities.
Paths are simulation outcomes under assumptions, never guaranteed future performance or actual account returns.
